meaning:
A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.14.1
§ Tidal = "great son"
chief of various nomadic tribes and an ally of Chedorlaomer

elsewhere.note: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,
